packages.name: Stakeholders
packages.description: The parties that take part in the CDM process and originate or receive its information.

packages.name: Flights
packages.description: The flight, turn-round, aircraft, and the flight plan and slot that describe them, including the flight's operational status.

packages.name: Timings
packages.description: The time quantities that describe a flight's progress, each with its origin, accuracy, and tolerance.

packages.name: Milestones
packages.description: The sixteen CDM milestone events, each with its trigger, timing rule, effect, and procedure.

packages.name: Systems
packages.description: The technical systems that hold, compute, and display process information, including the CDM platform and its actions.

packages.name: Messages
packages.description: The messages exchanged between stakeholders and systems.

classes.name: AirportCDMPartner
classes.definition: A party that takes part in the Airport CDM process and originates or receives process information.

attributes.name: partnerId
attributes.description: Identifier of the stakeholder.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the stakeholder organisation.

classes.name: AircraftOperator
classes.definition: The airline (AO) that operates the flight, submits the ATC Flight Plan and provides estimates such as TOBT.

classes.name: GroundHandler
classes.definition: The Ground Handler (GH) that, with the Aircraft Operator, manages the turn-round and provides estimates such as TOBT and ARDT.

classes.name: ATCUnit
classes.definition: An air traffic control unit (ATS, ACC, Approach, or Tower) that provides radar/ATC information and manages the pre-departure sequence.

classes.name: NetworkOperations
classes.definition: The network management function that issues CTOT, receives DPI messages and monitors flight progress via ETFMS.

classes.name: Aircrew
classes.definition: The flight crew who coordinate with the Ground Handler and request start-up from ATC.

classes.name: Aircraft
classes.definition: The physical aircraft assigned to a flight, described by type and registration information carried in the ATC Flight Plan.

attributes.name: registration
attributes.description: Aircraft registration, fed to Network Operations via the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: aircraftType
attributes.description: Type of aircraft, which the flight plan may be used to update.

classes.name: Flight
classes.definition: An arriving or departing operation of an aircraft turn-round, tracked through the sixteen CDM milestones with its operational status and time quantities.

attributes.name: flightId
attributes.description: Identifier of the flight.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Whether the flight is the arrival or the departure leg of the turn-round.

attributes.name: operationalStatus
attributes.description: Status changed by each milestone, e.g. INITIATED, AIRBORNE, FIR, FINAL, LANDED, IN-BLOCK, SEQUENCED, BOARDING, READY, OFF-BLOCK, DEPARTED / TAKE OFF.

attributes.name: regulated
attributes.description: Whether the flight is regulated and has received a CTOT; regulated flights usually have priority over unregulated flights (M2).

attributes.name: eobt
attributes.description: Estimated Off-Block Time of the flight.

attributes.name: tobt
attributes.description: Target Off-Block Time of the flight, appended each time it is updated.

attributes.name: aobt
attributes.description: Actual Off-Block Time recorded at push-back.

attributes.name: eldt
attributes.description: Estimated Landing Time of the flight, updated at multiple milestones.

attributes.name: eibt
attributes.description: Estimated In-Block Time computed from ELDT and EXIT, or ALDT and EXIT.

attributes.name: aldt
attributes.description: Actual Landing Time recorded at touch-down.

attributes.name: aibt
attributes.description: Actual In-Block Time recorded on arrival at the stand.

attributes.name: etot
attributes.description: Estimated Take-Off Time, updated for a departure at M1.

attributes.name: ttot
attributes.description: Target Take-Off Time, recalculated at every milestone from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT or TOBT+EXOT.

attributes.name: ctot
attributes.description: Calculated Take-Off Time issued by Network Operations at EOBT-2h for regulated flights.

attributes.name: atot
attributes.description: Actual Take-Off Time recorded at take-off.

attributes.name: asbt
attributes.description: Actual Start Boarding Time.

attributes.name: ardt
attributes.description: Actual Ready Time when the aircraft is ready to taxi.

attributes.name: asrt
attributes.description: Actual Start-up Request Time.

attributes.name: asat
attributes.description: Actual Start-up Approval Time.

attributes.name: tsat
attributes.description: Target Start-Up Approval Time issued by ATC.

attributes.name: exot
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-Out Time calculated by ATC based on traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use and holding-point waiting time.

attributes.name: exit
attributes.description: Estimated Taxi-In Time, used with ELDT/ALDT to compute EIBT.

attributes.name: mttt
attributes.description: Minimum/estimated Turn-Round Time used as basis for TOBT/TTOT calculation.

classes.name: TurnRound
classes.definition: The aircraft turn-round, normally comprising a related arriving and departing flight, analysed afterwards using the recorded successive time values.

attributes.name: turnRoundId
attributes.description: Identifier of the turn-round.

classes.name: ATCFlightPlan
classes.definition: The ICAO flight plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator and distributed by the IFPS, against which flight estimates are checked for consistency.

attributes.name: sobt
attributes.description: Scheduled Off-Block Time fed to Network Operations via the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: departureAerodrome
attributes.description: ADEP, distributed to all involved ATC units.

attributes.name: destinationAerodrome
attributes.description: First destination, fed to Network Operations via the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: isRepetitive
attributes.description: Whether the plan is a repetitive flight plan (RFPL) covering daily or weekly flights.

classes.name: AirportSlot
classes.definition: The airport slot programme entry with which the ATC Flight Plan and airport flight data must be consistent.

attributes.name: slotTime
attributes.description: The slot time allocated to the flight.

classes.name: AirportFlightData
classes.definition: The airport's own local flight data used together with the ATC Flight Plan and the Airport Slot to check consistency before the first E-DPI.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Local airport flight data checked for consistency.

classes.name: TimeQuantity
classes.definition: A time quantity that describes a flight's progress, with its originator, accuracy and tolerance; every successive value is kept rather than overwritten.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The time value of this quantity.

attributes.name: originator
attributes.description: The stakeholder or system that provided or updated this value.

attributes.name: timeOfUpdate
attributes.description: When this value was appended.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: The stated accuracy of the value, e.g. +/- 1 minute.

operations.name: appendValue
operations.description: Appends a new value with its originator and time of update rather than overwriting, so the turn-round can be analysed afterwards.

classes.name: EOBT
classes.definition: Estimated Off-Block Time, the reference against which TOBT and other estimates are compared.

classes.name: TOBT
classes.definition: Target Off-Block Time provided or confirmed by the AO/GH, used as the basis for TTOT calculation.

classes.name: AOBT
classes.definition: Actual Off-Block Time, the moment the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position.

classes.name: ELDT
classes.definition: Estimated Landing Time, updated at flight-plan activation, EOBT-2h, take-off, radar detection and final approach.

classes.name: EIBT
classes.definition: Estimated In-Block Time, computed using ELDT (or ALDT) and the Estimated Taxi-In Time (EXIT).

classes.name: ALDT
classes.definition: Actual Landing Time, the time an aircraft touches down, accurate to +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: AIBT
classes.definition: Actual In-Block Time, the time an aircraft arrives in-blocks, accurate to +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: ETOT
classes.definition: Estimated Take-Off Time, updated for a departure at flight-plan activation.

classes.name: TTOT
classes.definition: Target Take-Off Time, recalculated at each milestone from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT (or EOBT+EXOT) unless overridden by TOBT+EXOT, and reported to Network Operations when it changes beyond tolerance.

classes.name: CTOT
classes.definition: Calculated Take-Off Time issued by Network Operations at EOBT-2h for regulated flights.

classes.name: ATOT
classes.definition: Actual Take-Off Time, the time an aircraft takes off, accurate to +/- 1 minute.

classes.name: ASBT
classes.definition: Actual Start Boarding Time, when the gate opens for passengers to physically board.

classes.name: ARDT
classes.definition: Actual Ready Time, when doors are closed, bridge removed and push-back vehicle connected.

classes.name: ASRT
classes.definition: Actual Start-up Request Time, when the pilot requests start-up.

classes.name: ASAT
classes.definition: Actual Start-up Approval Time, when the aircraft receives start-up approval.

classes.name: TSAT
classes.definition: Target Start-Up Approval Time issued by ATC t-minutes before EOBT.

classes.name: EXOT
classes.definition: Estimated Taxi-Out Time, calculated by the ATC system from predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use and holding-position waiting period.

classes.name: EXIT
classes.definition: Estimated Taxi-In Time, used with ELDT/ALDT to compute EIBT and to determine the stand/gate change deadline.

classes.name: MTTT
classes.definition: The (minimum/estimated) turn-round period used as the basis for TOBT and TTOT calculation after landing/in-block/ground-handling milestones.

classes.name: Milestone
classes.definition: One of the sixteen CDM milestone events, each with a defined trigger, timing rule, effect and procedure that checks and updates flight estimates.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The event(s) that trigger this milestone's process.

attributes.name: newOperationalStatus
attributes.description: The operational status the flight changes to at this milestone.

attributes.name: accuracy
attributes.description: Stated accuracy of the milestone's time data, e.g. +/- 1 minute.

operations.name: changeOperationalStatus
operations.description: Changes the flight's operational status as stated for this milestone.

classes.name: FlightPlanActivatedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 1: the ATC Flight Plan is submitted and the Airport CDM Platform is initiated for the flight.

operations.name: checkConsistency
operations.description: Checks consistency between the ATC Flight Plan, Airport Slot and Airport flight data before the first E-DPI is sent.

operations.name: confirmFlightToNetworkOperations
operations.description: Confirms the flight to Network Operations and allows further local processing, triggered by first activation (earliest EOBT-3hr) or new/late submissions after cancellation or revised EOBT.

classes.name: EOBTMinus2hMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 2: at EOBT-2hr regulated flights receive a CTOT and estimates are checked against the ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: checkEstimatesConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH flight estimates are consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, verifying feasibility of the estimated off-block time at EOBT-2hrs.

operations.name: calculateTTOT
operations.description: Calculates TTOT from EIBT+MTTT+EXOT if later than EOBT+EXOT, or TOBT+EXOT if TOBT was manually input, overriding the EIBT+MTTT estimate.

operations.name: markAsRegulated
operations.description: Marks appropriate fields as REGULATED for flights that receive a CTOT.

classes.name: TakeOffFromOutstationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 3: the ATOT from the outstation (ADEP) is provided to Network Operations and the Aircraft Operator.

operations.name: checkEstimatedLandingConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH estimated landing time after outstation take-off is consistent with the outbound ATC Flight Plan.

operations.name: calculateELDT
operations.description: Calculates ELDT using ATOT and the Estimated Elapsed Time on the FPL.

operations.name: checkTTOTTolerance
operations.description: Respects a TTOT tolerance of 5 minutes before Network Operations is informed of updated TTOT.

classes.name: LocalRadarUpdateMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 4: the flight enters the FIR or local airspace, detected by radar via the assigned SSR code.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan, given updated ELDT/EIBT.

operations.name: checkStandGateChangeDeadline
operations.description: Checks that, taking into account EXIT, any stand or gate change is not preferred after ELDT-30 minutes.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTolerated
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalApproachMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 5: the flight enters the Final Approach phase at the destination airport, typically 2 to 5 minutes from landing.

operations.name: commenceTOBTProcess
operations.description: Commences the TOBT process and checks whether AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given updated ELDT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTolerated
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: LandedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 6: ALDT, the time an aircraft touches down, triggers an update of downstream estimates.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given ALDT.

operations.name: calculateEIBT
operations.description: Updates EIBT according to ALDT+EXIT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTolerated
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: InBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 7: AIBT, the time an aircraft arrives in-blocks, triggers an update of downstream estimates.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given AIBT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTolerated
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: GroundHandlingStartedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 8: ACGT, the commencement of ground handling operations, specific to first-of-day or long-term-parked flights, triggers an update of TOBT.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan given ACGT.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTolerated
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: FinalTOBTConfirmationMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 9: the time at which AO/GH provide their most accurate TOBT, t minutes before EOBT, prior to TSAT issue.

operations.name: checkTOBTConsistency
operations.description: Checks whether AO/GH TOBT is consistent with the ATC Flight Plan at the predefined local time before TSAT issue, triggered by a new TOBT or TTOT update.

operations.name: calculateEXOT
operations.description: Following receipt of TOBT, the ATC system calculates EXOT based on predicted traffic load, gate/stand location, runway in use and holding-position waiting period.

operations.name: informNetworkOperationsIfTolerated
operations.description: Informs Network Operations when TTOT changes by more than the agreed TTOT tolerance.

classes.name: TSATIssuedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 10: ATC issues the Target Start-Up Approval Time, t minutes before EOBT.

operations.name: informPartnersOfTSAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant partners of the TSAT allocated to the flight; Network Operations is informed by a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights.

operations.name: checkTOBTUpdateCount
operations.description: Checks whether the number of TOBT updates after TSAT has been issued exceeds a locally defined tolerance; if exceeded, TOBT input is processed per local procedure.

classes.name: BoardingStartsMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 11: the gate opens for passengers to physically start boarding.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start Boarding Time when it occurs.

operations.name: checkBoardingStatus
operations.description: At a locally defined time before TOBT, checks the boarding status and informs the AO/GH if TOBT needs updating.

classes.name: AircraftReadyMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 12: all doors closed, boarding bridge removed and push-back vehicle connected, ready to taxi.

operations.name: informPartnersOfARDT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of ARDT/RDY confirming the flight follows the indicated TOBT.

operations.name: checkReadyStatusReceived
operations.description: At TOBT + tolerance, informs the AO/GH that TOBT has passed and no ready status message has yet been received.

classes.name: StartUpRequestedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 13: ATC records the time that start-up is requested, based on pilot request.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASRT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start-up Request Time when it occurs.

operations.name: alertIfNoStartUpRequest
operations.description: If start-up request is not made by TSAT + tolerance, alerts partners and informs AO/GH that TOBT should be updated.

classes.name: StartUpApprovedMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 14: ASAT, the time an aircraft receives its start-up approval.

operations.name: informPartnersOfASAT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of Actual Start-up Approval Time and that push-back clearance has been received.

operations.name: checkASATAgainstTSAT
operations.description: Checks if ASAT is in accordance with TSAT; if not granted at TSAT + tolerance, all relevant partners are informed and the flight is re-sequenced.

classes.name: OffBlockMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 15: AOBT, the time the aircraft pushes back/vacates the parking position.

operations.name: informPartnersOfAOBT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners of AOBT and that push-back/taxi has commenced; AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or at a defined time prior to TTOT in case of remote holding.

operations.name: checkTTOTToleranceAndInform
operations.description: After the first A-DPI is sent, checks TTOT updates against the TTOT tolerance before Network Operations is informed, with a new A-DPI, of the updated TTOT.

classes.name: TakeOffMilestone
classes.definition: Milestone 16: ATOT, the time an aircraft takes off from the runway.

operations.name: informPartnersOfATOT
operations.description: Informs all relevant Airport CDM Partners about the actual take-off, generates an airborne message, and removes the flight from the departure sequence.

classes.name: AirportCDMPlatform
classes.definition: The central system, initiated for each flight, that holds all available flight information, performs the milestone checks and records the CDM Operation actions (ACISP).

attributes.name: platformId
attributes.description: Identifier of the CDM Platform instance for the flight.

operations.name: updateELDTAndEOBTData
operations.description: M1 ACISP: updates ELDT and EIBT for an arrival, and EOBT and ETOT for a departure.

operations.name: updateETOTTTOTCTOT
operations.description: M2 ACISP: updates ETOT/TTOT/CTOT and marks appropriate fields as REGULATED.

operations.name: updateAfterOutstationTakeOff
operations.description: M3 ACISP: updates ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT.

operations.name: updateAfterRadarDetection
operations.description: M4 ACISP: updates ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT.

operations.name: updateAfterFinalApproach
operations.description: M5 ACISP: updates ELDT, EIBT, TOBT and TTOT.

operations.name: updateAfterLanding
operations.description: M6 ACISP: changes ELDT to ALDT and updates EIBT, TOBT and TTOT.

operations.name: updateAfterInBlock
operations.description: M7 ACISP: changes EIBT to AIBT and updates TOBT and TTOT.

operations.name: updateAfterGroundHandlingStart
operations.description: M8 ACISP: updates ETTT/TOBT and TTOT.

operations.name: recordAOBT
operations.description: M15 ACISP: records AOBT.

operations.name: recordATOT
operations.description: M16 ACISP: records ATOT.

classes.name: IFPS
classes.definition: The system that distributes the submitted ATC Flight Plan to all involved ATC units.

operations.name: distributeFlightPlan
operations.description: Distributes the ATC Flight Plan submitted by the Aircraft Operator to all involved ATC units.

classes.name: ETFMS
classes.definition: The Network Operations system that monitors flight progress and generates Flight Update Messages when within 3 hours flying time of destination.

operations.name: monitorProgress
operations.description: Monitors progress of the flight and sends a FUM providing updates of the flight's progress.

classes.name: RadarSystem
classes.definition: The ATC radar system that detects a flight by its assigned SSR code at defined FIR/TMA boundaries or on final approach.

operations.name: detectFlight
operations.description: Detects the flight crossing a defined FIR/ATC boundary, range/position, or level.

classes.name: ACARS
classes.definition: The aircraft communication system that can provide ALDT, AIBT, AOBT and ATOT (ON/IN/OUT/OFF).

classes.name: DPIProcess
classes.definition: The Departure Planning Information process that commences correct messaging with Network Operations if implemented.

operations.name: sendEDPI
operations.description: Sends the first E-DPI message, not sent if no or inconsistent information is provided; feeds Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination.

operations.name: sendTDPI
operations.description: At EOBT-2hrs, informs Network Operations through the first T-DPI message with the updated take-off time estimate.

operations.name: sendTDPIt
operations.description: Informs Network Operations about updated take-off time estimates using a T-DPI-t message after outstation take-off, if TTOT tolerance exceeded.

operations.name: sendTDPIs
operations.description: Informs Network Operations with a T-DPI-s for non-regulated flights when TSAT is issued.

operations.name: sendADPI
operations.description: AOBT always triggers an A-DPI message to Network Operations, or a new A-DPI when TTOT changes beyond tolerance.

classes.name: Message
classes.definition: A message exchanged between Airport CDM stakeholders and systems.

attributes.name: sender
attributes.description: Sender of the message.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Time the message was sent.

classes.name: DPIMessage
classes.definition: A Departure Planning Information message sent to Network Operations at defined points in the DPI process.

classes.name: EDPIMessage
classes.definition: The first E-DPI message, feeding Network Operations with consistent SOBT, aircraft registration and first destination data as early as possible.

classes.name: TDPIMessage
classes.definition: The T-DPI message informing Network Operations of the updated take-off time estimate at EOBT-2hrs.

classes.name: TDPItMessage
classes.definition: The T-DPI-t message informing Network Operations of updated take-off time estimates after outstation take-off.

classes.name: TDPIsMessage
classes.definition: The T-DPI-s message informing Network Operations of TSAT for non-regulated flights.

classes.name: ADPIMessage
classes.definition: The A-DPI message triggered by AOBT and sent to Network Operations when TTOT changes beyond tolerance.

classes.name: FUMMessage
classes.definition: The Flight Update Message sent by Network Operations providing updates of the flight's progress, used to update ELDT for inbound flights.

classes.name: FSAMessage
classes.definition: The FSA message sent after take-off.

classes.name: MVTMessage
classes.definition: The MVT (movement) message sent after take-off.
